# Xorg's errors for malformed XKB SetMap requests and for XKB requests without
# XkbUseExtension (issue #171 phase 4c), for malformed SetCompatMap /
# SetIndicatorMap requests (phase 4d) and for malformed SetNames / SetGeometry
# requests (phase 4e): Xvfb -noreset, layout=gb
# server: X.Org version 21.1.24 (xdpyinfo); `Xvfb -version` -> "Unrecognized option: -version" (not supported by this build)
# pacman -Q: xkeyboard-config 2.48-1 xorg-server-xvfb 21.1.24-1
# setxkbmap -rules evdev -model pc105 -layout gb; then one tools/xkb-mutation-probe.c run per
# request (fresh connections each time), sending xkb-setmap-errors/NAME.bin raw:
#   xreq:  on the actor after its XkbUseExtension; xreq0: on a connection without it;
#   atoms:xkbcomp-requests/identity/atoms.txt first for the SetNames / SetGeometry requests
#   (built from the recorded identity upload, whose atoms they use).
# Each request is built by this script from xkbcomp-requests/identity/1-SetMap.bin,
# 2-SetIndicatorMap.bin, 3-SetCompatMap.bin, 4-SetNames.bin or 5-SetGeometry.bin (the
# '## NAME' line says how). Lines: '= error=CODE value=V major=M minor=N' (major is this
# server's XKB opcode) or '= ok' for the few requests Xorg accepts, then the (empty)
# XkbGetMap delta and coremodmap as usual. The accepted ones come last (they change
# only names on this one server).
## access: the recorded identity SetMap, from a client that never called XkbUseExtension
> xreq0:xkb-setmap-errors/access.bin
= error=10 value=0 major=135 minor=9
coremodmap kpm=3 0:50,62,0 1:66,0,0 2:37,105,0 3:64,204,205 4:77,0,0 5:203,0,0 6:133,134,206 7:92,0,0
